commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Accept a stale reference's proposed range with one explicit repin, including on apply-slide slides
commits.body:
references --stale shows each stale reference's proposal, its diff, and the
accept command. repin --accept-proposed takes a scope, keeps the note and the
record, and refuses a reference with nothing proposed. apply-slide
--print-current prints a managed slide's complete current request.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Lead reconcile with the references this change made stale
commits.body:
The text report opens with one line per reference the change made stale,
old range -> proposed range, and the accept command. Pre-existing debt is a
count; --all lists its tasks. Documentation gaps, re-reads, and user
choices print one line each. JSON gains a leading summary and
proposals; --json --summary emits only the summary.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Say what the change made stale in status, review list, and review create
commits.body:
One rule everywhere: stale at the head and either current at the merge-base
or pinned during the change. status (comparing) prints it under the header
and adds stale_by_change; review list reports it per open review, with
proposals for stale Item references; review create's next steps name it.
Review list and create read only references into files the range touches.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Refresh a review deck's coverage after a push with one command
commits.body:
review refresh-coverage re-pins references whose lines only moved and
whole-file references whose file event is still in the range, gives newly
changed lines to the one Item already covering their file, and reports stale
references with their proposals and accept commands, never accepting them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Keep deleted-side evidence out of what the change made stale
commits.body:
A reference pinned at the merge-base to lines the change removed documents
what the change took out; it is current at the base by design. It is now
counted as deleted_side instead of being flagged with a misleading proposal.
Status, review list, and review create carry proposals without their diffs,
and the e2e harness reads a large status report without Node's 1 MiB cap.

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Report new lines with a proposed owner instead of assigning them, and keep each review reference's side
commits.body:
refresh-coverage no longer extends an Item on its own: newly changed lines
are reported uncovered with the one Item covering their file as the
proposed owner and the exact accept command. --accept-proposed [--path P]
gives them to it under a neutral "added in <head>" note unless --note says
more. A new-side reference stale at the head now needs judgment in
refresh-coverage, repin --accept-proposed, and review list instead of being
re-pinned to or counted current at the merge-base. repin --accept-proposed
--all skips and reports an open review whose range cannot be read.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Flag proposals that take in new lines, show neighbouring hunks, and refuse brace-only anchors
commits.body:
A proposal is widened whenever it takes in lines the pinned range did not
have, not only when a hunk crosses its edge, so a sibling function git slid
inside the range is flagged. Its diff shows the nearest hunk just before and
after the range, so an extracted helper or move is visible. Nothing is
proposed when the only lines an edit left in the range are braces, blank, or
punctuation, which anchor nothing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Excuse only evidence written during the change as deleted-side
commits.body:
A living reference pinned at the merge-base to lines the change deleted
was counted deleted_side, hiding the change's own regression when the
documentation predates it (a companion Saga pins at the code's main head).
The exception now applies only when the Saga that documented the merge-base
has no identical reference; documentation that already described the
deleted lines is listed as made stale.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Publish nothing for an unchanged slide update and refuse an ambiguous slide ID
commits.body:
An apply-slide update identical to the current revision (apply-slide
--print-current applied as printed) no longer appends a no-op revision; it
reports the slide unchanged. --print-current and managed evidence repair
refuse a bare slide ID that slides of several decks share and name each
target instead of silently taking the first deck's.
